\textit{Note.} Ratio = max $\div$ min of the two hindsight RMSEs (the pre-registered definition of P-T4 and P-O3), so it is $\ge$ 1 and the 'lower' column gives the direction: in O the RTS-UKF is lower on O\_r1 and O\_r2 and the FGO batch on O\_r3b.
